gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Plain-spoken and approachable, the body here sits beside Mystery Quest, a nostalgic display face with open-jawed curves. Noto Sans Cherokee runs deep letters under short stalks, its wide-gapped e keeping a full paragraph friendly.
